descriptor.retrieval_description: Flexible plastic snack pouch containing loose contents. The intended contact region is dry, flexible, and conforms to opposing compliant fingers with crinkled film geometry.

descriptor.local_geometry: Flexible flat surfaces with slight pillowing from contents and crimped edges
